title: CY50109: Chemistry And Biology Of Carbohydrates
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NilIntroduction and nomenclature; Structure and stereochemistry
of monosaccharides; The sugars in solution; Conformation of sugars. Reactions
at the anomeric center; Reactions at the non anomeric centers. Protecting
groups relevant to carbohydrates. Anhydro-, amino-, thio-, unsaturated- and
branched-chain sugars. Total synthesis of other natural products from sugar
chirons. Complex Glycosides, carbohydrate antibiotics; carbohydrates on cell
surfaces; oligosaccharides with biological relevance; glycolysis; introduction
to inositol.Books: 1) Monosaccharides: Their Chemistry and Role in Natural
Products, P.M. Collins,and R.J. Ferrier, 1995, Wiley, New York. ISBN: 0-47195343-1 ; Carbohydrates-Structure and Biology, J. Lehmann, 1998, Thieme, New
York, ISBN:
3-13-110771-5.
